top10_largest_improvements.definition: Select the 10 largest legacy-minus-intersection CD changes on the common measurable subset. Sum their changes / sum all changes. This descriptive ratio can exceed 1 when other objects offset improvements; it is not a causal attribution.
top10_largest_improvements.ratio_note: Share is unavailable when the overall mean worsens; the separately retained signed ratio is descriptive arithmetic, not an improvement share.

interpretation_limits: All comparisons are descriptive. Fine-tuning, loss changes and candidate/symmetry rules changed together; this comparison does not isolate feedback-module causality.
Posterior-mean reconstruction uses aligned GT face slots. Archived diffusion latents have no guaranteed GT face correspondence, so aligned MAE and topology PR/F1 must remain unavailable there.
Archived-latent evaluation replaces the decoder on the same historical latent inputs; it is not new diffusion sampling or an end-to-end real-photo evaluation.
Zero unilateral pairs follows explicitly symmetric connection logits, not evidence that the network learned exact shared geometry. Reciprocal-curve summaries use each method's own active pair set.
Raw reciprocal rows are half-edge predictions, not arbitrary native CAD edge/coedge/UV reconstruction. Pair-set accuracy does not establish trim, sewing, or solid validity.
Post geometry is evaluated on the common measurable subset, not all intended objects or only valid solids. Raw-grid and sampled-STEP CD protocols differ and must not be directly equated.
Post CD mean changes can be dominated by a few objects. Top-10 net contribution and win counts supplement the mean; neither demonstrates a causal mechanism.
Geometry errors/timeouts do not automatically mean no valid STEP; native solid status and metric computability are separate.
Legacy post records and timings are read-only historical results with verified protocol compatibility, not rerun in this invocation.
The 7 contract-unsupported original test objects remain outside the accepted 2417 and inside the original denominator 2424.
